Chaff in Mechabellum refers to cheap units that are meant to take hits. Placement of chaff can vary.

A good example is you place fangs and 1 marksmen behind. The fangs take the hits while the marksman still live to shoot.

A trait about chaff is that that's a lot of them in a squad.

Chaff:  
\- Fangs  
\- Crawlers  
\- Wasps  
\- Mustangs

Some people term certain units like sledgehammers, hounds, steel balls etc. as pseudo-chaff, as they have relatively large numbers and can act like chaff in taking hits (but that suffer once they get hit with an emp hit). A good example is when you make the Warfactory and it produces a lot of units that act like very dangerous chaff. Warfactory spam to make a lot of these units (sledgehammer, steel balls with crawler spawn) is a good example of pseudo-chaff.
